stepsTitle: A BETTER WAY TO PLAN THE NEXT MEAL
steps: Explore the food guide and shortlist what catches your eye.
Add guest numbers, your preferred location and the occasion.
Download a clear plan and contact the business to confirm what’s possible.
plannerCopy: Put the details in one place before asking about a group meal. This draft helps you explain what you have in mind; it does not reserve a table or place an order.
notesPlaceholder: Preferred dishes, arrival time, dietary questions to discuss…
visitCopy: The linked public page also references a location behind Ayele Building near UPSA. Confirm which branch is right for your visit.
visitNote: Published phone numbers and hours differ between sources. Check the business social page before travelling. No live opening status is claimed here.
faq: Does this plan reserve a table?
No. It is a planning draft. Confirm the date, party size, venue and any catering arrangements directly with Asanka Local.
Can I rely on the food guide for allergies?
No. Confirm ingredients and cross-contact directly with the restaurant. Groundnut soup contains groundnuts; other dishes may contain allergens that are not listed here.
Are the menu and prices live?
No live menu or prices are claimed. The guide uses publicly described dishes; actual availability and prices need business confirmation.
problem: Potential guests must piece together dish explanations, locations and contact details. A structured group-meal plan collects party size, date, branch and preferred dishes before a conversation.
websiteStatus: No current standalone official website verified. Facebook is linked as the website by Restaurants10. A historical GhanaYello listing mentions asankaghana.com; its current status was not established. Do not claim they never had a website.
